entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To get started, could you tell me which item you're calling about? And what specifically is the issue with it?
It's the pair of cycling shoes I bought. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I was so excited for them, but they're just not working out. I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels.
Oh no, getting blisters is certainly not the experience we want for our riders. Is it a fit issue, or perhaps a technical fault with the shoe itself?

I think it's the fit. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, thinking that might change the pressure points, but it hasn't helped. I was really counting on these, and I've been a loyal customer. I just really need to get my money back if possible.

I completely understand your frustration. Let me pull up your account and check the return eligibility. One moment please... Okay, I see the order for the cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered 44 days ago.
Oh... is that too long? I was just hoping for a refund. I really needed that money for some other things coming up.
Not at all. You're well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you. There's no problem at all.
Really? Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them. Thank you so much, Diana.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could help. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be issued.
That's perfect. You've been a great help. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
